about: Exploratory after-data H3 v2 correction. V1 H3-S1 stopped after 2/8 rows because the first Warrant workspace episode had 195 deterministic context spans, exceeding the pre-registered 192-request per-episode ceiling before its audit could finish. This v2 raises only that episode ceiling to 384; cases, prompts, rows, repeats, ARGUS method, model and scorer are unchanged. V1 evidence is retained under experiment 20261010-deepseek-h3-exploratory-v1. Use --set h3_cases=<path> --set h3_plan=<path> --set results_root=<confirmed checkout> and --artifact-root <pinned ARGUS checkout>.
authorization_basis: User explicitly directed: after giving the plan, run without waiting for another confirmation. V1 spent $0.04668510. V2 stages are capped at $0.70 and $2.50; combined actual-plus-maximum is $3.24668510, below the previously presented $3.25 total. Run S2 only if the complete V2 S1 gate passes.

case_plan.cases: 2 GT-validated dev pairs (workspace user_task_35 and slack user_task_2); banking user_task_2 is eval held out
case_plan.full_plan: 2 pairs x 2 arms x 5 repeats = 20 episodes per row

pricing_reverification.basis: Conservative peak, input cache hits charged as misses. The shared guard's historical 2026-09-30 snapshot has the same numeric rates; its receipt retains that historical id. Recheck alias and rates before any paid launch.

cost_anchor.source: V1 H3-S1, results experiment 20261010-deepseek-h3-exploratory-v1; correction prompted by a deterministic context-span workload discovered after V1
cost_anchor.observed: V1 2/8 rows attempted: one valid undefended workspace run, one Warrant row invalid at the 192 per-episode request ceiling; guard total 195 forwarded requests, 149206 tokens, $0.04668510
cost_anchor.maximum_episode: V1 workspace Warrant had 195 context spans and 190 judge plus 2 agent requests before local refusal; 384 requests is a protective ceiling, not an expected cost
cost_anchor.caps_rule: V2 S1 cap $0.70 and V2 S2 cap $2.50 keep V1 actual plus V2 maximum below $3.25. The stage USD/token/request guard remains the hard bound. Cross-case transfer remains unverified.
